audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Vault (E) with the blind/nearsight. The vision hinder is Blinding Assault (Q); Vault knocks her off you, slows, and briefly interrupts.
audit.why: Q Blinding Assault: 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area'. E Vault: 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s, 'dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing... briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away'.
audit.corrected: Blind = Q at 1025 range on 11s; Vault = the 12s reposition/interrupt. Both re-pointed and given numbers.

audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Quinn; tone set to the FAV orange and the final rating line reworded.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind): matchup-defining — Her self-peel. R her when down. Track it before every engage. - Quinn Vault: Dashes to a target, knocks back, and blinds their next attacks. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Quinn Vault (E): matchup-defining — a 675-range dash that knocks her off you and slows, 12s at rank 1. - Quinn Blinding Assault (Q): the nearsight, 1025 range on 11s — that is what blinds you, not Vault.

edits.before: Her self-peel. R her when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Vault is her self-peel, 12s at rank 1 — commit once she spends it.

edits.before: That is Quinn's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Blinding Assault is the nearsight on an 11s cooldown — trade after it goes.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines has a 3s cooldown and roams the map — hold lane priority and ping her the second she leaves, or she wins the game elsewhere.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — you have only Q and no Darkness Rise aura yet, so just farm and don't chase her around the wave (her Harrier mark and W move speed mean you'll never catch her). The lane flips at 2 and 3: once Obliterate (Q) and Indestructible (W) are up, every time she steps in to last-hit she eats a single-target Q smash and you bank shield off her pokes. Don't fling Q at the whole wave hoping to clip her — hold it for when she commits to an auto, and respect her E Vault: it dashes her over you, knocks you back and nearsights you, so it cancels your auto-trade and resets her distance. Bait the Vault, then trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — you have only Q and no Darkness Rise aura yet, so just farm and don't chase her around the wave (her Harrier mark and W move speed mean you'll never catch her). The lane flips at 2 and 3: once Obliterate (Q) and Indestructible (W) are up, every time she steps in to last-hit she eats a single-target Q smash and you bank shield off her pokes. Don't fling Q at the whole wave hoping to clip her — hold it for when she commits to an auto, and respect Vault (E, 12s): it dashes her over you, interrupts you and resets her distance, while the nearsight comes off Blinding Assault (Q) on 11s. Bait the Vault, then trade.

edits.before: Use E (Vault) dash for the knockback + nearsight to cancel your trade, then kite back out of aura range
edits.after: Use Vault's dash and knockback to interrupt your trade, then nearsight you with Blinding Assault
